the proposed dataset can be used to test the ability to interactively learn from the user, and the interactive learning can help to overcome the problem of sparse facts in open-domain dialog system.

(i) the dataset can be used to train a dialog system in a way that it can learn from users during the dialog and (ii) the dialog system can learn from the dataset and perform better on the test set than the baseline dialog system.

(1) the interactive learning of denotations from users is possible, (2) users are able to learn the denotations and explain the questions in a reasonable time and with a good success rate, (3) the interactive learning is a good alternative to the manual annotation and (4) the proposed dataset is a good benchmark for testing interactive learning in dialog systems.

the following research question: How can we collect data to enable interactive learning of dialog systems?

the following aspects of the problem:
1) the ability of the dialog system to collect new denotations and explanations from the users, 2) the ability of users to provide correct explanations and to understand the dialog system’s requests for denotations and 3) the ability of dialog system to learn from these denotations and explanation.
the following questions: (1) Can dialog systems learn new facts from users? (2) How can the dialog systems learn new denotations from users?

the dataset is a great source of information for the development and testing of dialog systems.
the proposed dataset can be used for evaluating and developing dialog systems with interactive learning capabilities.

, the proposed dataset, in addition to its use in interactive learning, can be also used for evaluating the performance of the dialog system in terms of its ability in learning facts from the user utterances and its ability to generate a natural and fluent dialog.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a dataset which can be used to test the ability to learn new facts and to evaluate the performance of dialog system with respect to this ability.
, the proposed dataset allows to simulate the process of interactive learning from users, which is a crucial step for the improvement of dialog system's ability to reason.
we have collected a new dataset, which is a step towards the interactive learning for dialog systems, and we have evaluated the interactive learning on this dataset.

interactive learning of denotations can be used for improving the performance of open domain dialog systems.
the interactive learning of new facts from user feedback can be done in a natural way and can be applied to a wide range of domains.
interactive learning is a viable approach for dialog systems and can help them to improve their knowledge base.
